releases.notes:
Touhou Little Maid: Maid Crafting
Automation addon for [Touhou Little Maid](https://modrinth.com/mod/touhou-little-maid). Maids pull materials from a Refined Storage network and walk to the right crafting station to fully automate your crafting!
Features
Maid crafting task
Switch a maid to the Crafting work mode and she will:
Automatically pull materials from a nearby Refined Storage network
Walk to the required crafting station
Insert the finished items back into the Refined Storage network
"I Think I Have Materials" maid curio
Equip this curio and the maid will recursively craft missing materials until everything is ready. Crafting a chest without planks? She will craft the planks first.

One-click craft requests (JEI integration)
JEI recipe page button: a Hakurei Gohei button on the recipe page asks a nearby maid to craft the displayed item.
C hotkey: hover an item in JEI and press C to send a craft request. Scrolls keep their spell & level NBT.
Precise scroll crafting
Scrolls are distinguished by NBT; requests preserve spell + level exactly.
Auto-plans direct writing or level-by-level upgrades on the Arcane Anvil.
Consumes rarity-matched ink, paper, and the school's focus item.
Missing materials are recursively crafted first instead of failing outright.
Usage
Set up a Refined Storage network (controller + terminal) and the stations you need.
Set your maid's work mode to Crafting.
(Recommended) Give the maid the I Think I Have Materials curio for auto-recursive crafting.
Open JEI, view a recipe, click the gohei button, or hover the item and press C.
The nearest owned maid in Crafting mode (within 16 blocks) picks up the task.
Dependencies
Required

Forge 47.x (Minecraft 1.20.1)
[Touhou Little Maid](https://modrinth.com/mod/touhou-little-maid) >= 1.5.3
[Refined Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/refined-storage) >= 1.12.4
[JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) (client)
Optional (feature disabled when missing)

[Goety](https://modrinth.com/mod/goety) - Dark Altar
[Ars Nouveau](https://modrinth.com/mod/ars-nouveau) - Enchanting Apparatus & Imbuement Chamber
[Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks](https://modrinth.com/mod/irons-spells-n-spellbooks) - Scroll Writing Table & Arcane Anvil
Compatibility
Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge
Required on both client and server
Safe loading when optional mods are missing
